title: Coast Guard medevacs man 35 miles east of Manasquan Inlet, NJ
description: An MH-65 Dolphin helicopter aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, New Jersey, hoists an ailing man aboard a fishing vessel approximately 35 miles east of Manasquan Inlet, New Jersey, April 29, 2018. The fishing vessel’s captain notified the Coast Guard at about 5:45 p.m. that the man was suffering from a possible stroke and needed a medical evacuation. (U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Atlantic City/Released)
